detail.title: Dahua 1024CH 48-bay 6U Embedded Video Storage
detail.overview: Compare Favourite EVS8248X Dahua 1024CH 48-bay 6U Embedded Video Storage Key Points • Max. 1024-ch IP Camera Inputs • Max. 2048 Mbps Incoming/Recording/Forwarding Bandwidth • 48 Bays, SAS/SATA, Hot-Swap • RAID 0/1/5/6/10/50/60, Hot Spare, N+M Cluster • Video Stream/Picture Direct Storage Mode and IPSAN Storage Mode • Modular and Drawer-like Design • 2+1 Redundant 80PLUS Platinum Power Supply Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.AI by Camera: Face detection, face recognition, IVS (abandoned object, missing object, loitering, crowd gathering, parking, fence-crossing, fast moving, tripwire and intrusion), video metadata (human, vehicle, non-motor vehicle), vehicle recognition, people counting (fisheye or people counting camera required),face & body detection, crowd distribution, smart thermal (call detection, visible channel- smoking detection, thermal channel-smoking detection)
General.Thermal: Works with camera for fire alarm, temperature alarm, temperature difference alarm, hot spot, cold spot, smoking and calling
General.People Counting: Works with camera for tripwire people counting, regional people counting and queue people counting
General.Bullet-PTZ Smart Track: Works with camera for manual tracking, auto tracking, click positioning and select positioning
General.Multi-screen Display: Customized display, max 16-channel PCAPP live view
General.Third-party Camera Access: ONVIF; RTSP; Sony; Panasonic; Axis; Arecont; Pelco; Canon; Samsung
General.Video Compression: Smart H.265+; H.265; Smart H.264+; H.264; MJPEG
General.Network Protocol: HTTP; HTTPS; TCP/IP; IPv4; RTSP; UDP; SMTP; NTP; DHCP; DNS; DDNS; iSCSI; FTP; SMB; NFS; UPnP; SNMP; IPv6
General.Browser: Chrome; PCAPP; IE9 or higher; Firefox
General.Network Mode: Multiple-address mode; Load balance; Fault-tolerance;Link aggregation
General.Record Mode: Auto record; manual record; motion detection; IO alarm
General.Backup Method: Peripheral eSATA storage device; peripheral USB storage device
General.Playback Function: 1. Play, pause, stop, fast forward, fast backward, reverse play, frame by frame 2. Full-screen, backup (clip; file), snapshot, digital zoom, audio on; off
General.Video Direct Storage (Private Protocol): Incoming: 1024-channel (bandwidth: 2048 Mbps) Recording: 1024-channel (bandwidth: 2048 Mbps) Outgoing: 1024-channel (bandwidth: 2048 Mbps) Playback: 32-channel (bandwidth: 64 Mbps)
General.Video Direct Storage (Onvif): Incoming: 1024-channel (bandwidth: 2048 Mbps) Recording: 1024-channel (bandwidth: 2048 Mbps) Outgoing: 1024-channel (bandwidth: 2048 Mbps) Playback: 32-channel (bandwidth: 64 Mbps)
General.Video Direct Storage (Auto Register): Incoming: 1024-channel (bandwidth: 2048 Mbps) Recording: 1024-channel (bandwidth: 2048 Mbps) Outgoing: 1024-channel (bandwidth: 2048 Mbps) Playback: 32-channel (bandwidth: 64 Mbps)
General.Picture Direct Storage: Incoming: 400-channel (550 KB/picture) Recording: 400-channel (550 KB/picture) Outgoing: 400-channel (550 KB/picture)
General.RAID: RAID0; RAID1; RAID5; RAID6; RAID10; RAID50; RAID60
General.Record Management: Supports record control (continuous, event-based, scheduled, scheduled & event-based)
General.IPSAN Performance: 400-channel × 2 Mbps video stream writing and 24-channel × 2 Mbps video playback ( I/O size of VMS is 64 KB)
General.General Alarm: Motion detect; tampering; IPC external alarm
General.Anomaly Alarm: IPC offline alarm; storage error; HDD full; video frame loss; SSD exception; IP conflict; MAC conflict; login lock; fan malfunction; no HDD; power exception; disk health exception; RAID exception; low quota space; storage pool exception; temperature alarm; share service
General.Alarm Linkage: Record; snapshot (full image); alarm uploading; remote device alarm output; camera audio; buzzer; log; preset; email, smart tracking and warning light. Disarming alarm linkage action by period or one-click sync disarm configuration with channels
General.HDD Interface: 48 slots, SATA; SAS Max.20 TB/HDD hot swapping CMR support enterprise-grade HDD
General.Power Consumption: Working(all HDDs connected): ≤ 600W(2048 BTU/hr) Working(without HDD): ≤ 200W(682 BTU/hr) Rated: ≤ 1200W(4095 BTU/hr)
General.Certifications: CE: CE-LVD: EN 60950-1/IEC 60950-1 CE-EMC: EN 61000-3-2, EN 61000-3-3, EN 55032, EN 50130, EN 55024 FCC: Part 15 Subpart B
